note: Triennial election, 1930. No contests: the clerk's nominations (BNL 9 May 1930 p6) were declared elected, and in nine divisions with no nominations the retiring members were deemed re-elected (eight names printed for nine divisions). Antrim Urban returned two members, both unopposed; the 'Antrim Urban poll' recorded as a lead in the earlier pass is not supported by this report. Two nominees for the two Antrim Urban seats; 'The candidates have been declared elected.' (The same list later prints 'Antrim urban, Mr. T. Gillespie', a misprint for Randalstown Urban.) The 1933 round has Samuel Brennan and Fred T. Smith for Antrim Urban. Returned unopposed.
